title: Public charger access and usability
summary: The topic centers on public charger availability, ease of use, and charging access, but the sampled fragments mix favorable and unfavorable anecdotes while all are labeled undetermined.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention simple public charging experiences, charger shortages or outages, home charging to avoid queues, and some unrelated fragments that do not clearly express a stable sentiment.

limitations: All sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, so sentiment-specific conclusions cannot be drawn from this topic.
The examples mix charger usability, charger availability, charging speed, dealership infrastructure, and unrelated fragments such as door handle or ordering issues.
Some fragments are incomplete or too vague to interpret confidently, including the vehicle search for compatible chargers fragment and several 'surprised' statements.
The sample is stratified and not representative, so it should not be used to infer broader customer prevalence or defect rates.
